label: Language preferences
behaviour: Opens the language preferences, through the Review tab's KeyTips.

label: Grave accent on the next letter
behaviour: Puts a grave accent on the letter typed next.

label: Acute accent on the next letter
behaviour: Puts an acute accent on the letter typed next, or makes an eth from d.

label: Circumflex on the next letter
behaviour: Puts a circumflex on the letter typed next.

label: Tilde on the next letter
behaviour: Puts a tilde on the letter typed next.

label: Diaeresis on the next letter
behaviour: Puts a diaeresis on the letter typed next.

label: Ring on the next a
behaviour: Puts a ring on the a typed next.

label: Ligature or sharp s from the next letter
behaviour: Makes a ligature from the a or o typed next, or a sharp s from s.

label: Cedilla on the next c
behaviour: Puts a cedilla on the c typed next.

label: Stroke through the next o
behaviour: Puts a stroke through the o typed next.

label: Inverted question mark
behaviour: Types an inverted question mark.

label: Inverted exclamation mark
behaviour: Types an inverted exclamation mark.

label: Turn the Japanese input method on or off
condition: Only with a Japanese input method installed.
behaviour: Turns the Japanese input method on or off.

label: Turn the Korean input method on or off
condition: Only with a Korean input method installed.
behaviour: Turns the Korean input method on or off.

label: Turn the Chinese input method on or off
condition: Only with a Chinese input method installed.
behaviour: Turns the Chinese input method on or off.

label: Read Mode
behaviour: Switches to Read Mode, through the View tab's KeyTips.

label: Collapse
behaviour: Hides the text under the selected heading, one level at a time.

label: Show or hide character formatting
behaviour: Shows the outline's text with its character formatting, or plain.

label: Tab character
behaviour: Types a tab character, where Tab alone demotes the paragraph.

label: Start of the document
behaviour: Goes to the first screen of the document.

label: End of the document
behaviour: Goes to the last screen of the document.

label: Go to the page number typed
condition: Right after a page number is typed.
behaviour: Goes to the page whose number was just typed.

label: Leave Read Mode
behaviour: Leaves Read Mode for the view used before it.

label: Translator pane
behaviour: Opens the Translator pane on the selection.

label: Selection pane
behaviour: Opens the Selection pane, listing the page's shapes and pictures.

label: Show the action menu
condition: While a paste or AutoCorrect action button is shown.
behaviour: Opens the menu of the action button shown, such as Paste Options or AutoCorrect Options.

label: Go to the table of contents button
condition: When the selection is in a table of contents.
behaviour: Selects the button of the table of contents the selection is in.

label: Office 2003 menu keys
condition: Only the older menu sequences Word still accepts.
behaviour: Starts one of the older menu key sequences, such as Alt, E for the old Edit menu.

label: Leave the KeyTips
condition: While KeyTips are shown.
behaviour: Hides the KeyTips, or goes back one level of them.

label: Open the task pane's menu
behaviour: Opens the menu of the task pane that has focus, with its Size, Move and Close commands.

label: Next command in the task pane's menu
condition: While the task pane's menu is open.
behaviour: Moves to the next command in the task pane's menu.

label: Run the chosen command in the task pane's menu
condition: While the task pane's menu is open.
behaviour: Runs the command chosen in the task pane's menu, such as Close.

label: Previous page in Read Mode
behaviour: Goes to the previous screen.

label: Next page in Read Mode
behaviour: Goes to the next screen.
